title: None Other Lamb
description: None Other Lamb in Tonic Solfa: the solfa line by line with the words, staff notation, all 3 verses, and a piano to sing along with.
about: The words are by Christina Georgina Rossetti, first published in 1892. The tune, ROSSETTI, is by William Jeater (1907). This version of the melody and the words comes from the Open Hymnal Project.
underlay: None oth-er Lamb, none oth-er name, None oth-er hope in Heav'n or earth or sea, None oth-er hi-ding place from guilt and shame, None be-side Thee!

lines: None other Lamb, none other name,
None other hope in Heav'n or earth or sea,
None other hiding place from guilt and shame,
My faith burns low, my hope burns low;
Only my heart's desire cries out in me
By the deep thunder of its want and woe,
Lord, Thou art life, though I be dead;
Love's fire Thou art, however cold I be:
Nor Heav'n have I, nor place to lay my head,
